Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0139", "row_sha256": "4e452880f39e0690d292b68c570e782a2f5424d753e467ee7b23d74720f3112e", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm checking the sync client for the shared folder named orchard launch because the design exports are taking most of the upload on my laptop. the local folder is on the work laptop, and the folder is shared with the three people on the release team. i don't want to pause syncing or change what gets downloaded, i only want to lower the upload limit for this folder. in the advanced settings, the key is
sync.limit_uploads
could you set that limit to six no sorry make that four simultaneous uploads, and leave the other sync settings as they are. the number four is the maximum uploads at one time, not a count of files to remove. i want new design exports and the existing shared files to keep syncing, just with no more than four uploads running together. the uploads are most noticeable when i'm sending the afternoon batch of large image files, although the folder also has ordinary notes and small previews. if there is a separate global limit, don't change that, i mean the setting attached to orchard launch only. the client has shown two uploads in progress this morning, so please don't treat two as the limit i asked for. let me know if you need me to identify the folder in the client, but it should appear under shared with me.", "output": "I'm checking the sync client for the shared folder named orchard launch because the design exports are taking most of the upload on my laptop. The local folder is on the work laptop, and the folder is shared with the three people on the release team. I don't want to pause syncing or change what gets downloaded; I only want to lower the upload limit for this folder. In the advanced settings, the key is:
sync.limit_uploads
Could you set that limit to four simultaneous uploads, and leave the other sync settings as they are? The number four is the maximum uploads at one time, not a count of files to remove. I want new design exports and the existing shared files to keep syncing, just with no more than four uploads running together. The uploads are most noticeable when I'm sending the afternoon batch of large image files, although the folder also has ordinary notes and small previews. If there is a separate global limit, don't change that; I mean the setting attached to orchard launch only. The client has shown two uploads in progress this morning, so please don't treat two as the limit I asked for. Let me know if you need me to identify the folder in the client, but it should appear under shared with me."}]
